config.title: TLS Certificates
config.description: TLS certificates uploaded or managed by ngrok

config.title: Endpoint Status
config.description: Whether each indexed endpoint is currently online

config.title: Online Agents
config.description: ngrok agents currently connected to the account, with the authtoken each one uses

dataSourceConfig.sql: SELECT a."ip", t."description" AS "authtoken", a."agent_version", a."os", a."region", a."started_at", a."uptime" FROM "agents" a LEFT JOIN "authtokens" t ON a."credential.id" = t."id" ORDER BY a."uptime" DESC

config.title: Domain Certificate Status
config.description: Certificate state of each reserved domain

config.title: Certificates Expiring Soonest
config.description: TLS certificates ordered by days until expiry

config.title: Certificate Authorities Expiry
config.description: Mutual TLS certificate authorities ordered by days until expiry

config.title: Traffic Identities
config.description: Users who signed in to protected endpoints, most recently active first

config.title: Active Sessions
config.description: Traffic sessions of users signed in through endpoint identity policies

dataSourceConfig.sql: SELECT i."name", i."email", s."publicUrl", s."browser", s."countryCode", s."last_active", s."expires_at" FROM "sessions" s LEFT JOIN "identities" i ON s."userId" = i."id" ORDER BY s."last_active" DESC

config.title: Event Subscriptions
config.description: Event subscriptions that forward ngrok events to log export destinations
